app TypedDeliveryObserver
use std {EmailV1 as Mail} from=deployment.mail
Given
 role viewer
 role delivery_reader
 Entry { label:text="Notification", notification:delivery(Mail.send)? }
 Child in Entry { label:text="Child" }
 ## Label and receipt grants are independent; neither exposes the opaque delivery identity.
 policy Entry read=viewer fields=label
 policy Entry read=delivery_reader fields=notification.status,notification.result
 policy Child read=members
When
 crud Entry by=members fields=label
 crud Child by=members fields=label
 ## A parent delivery uses the actual current association, even when its wire field is projected away.
 scenario parentStatus(child:Child) by=members read=true -> bool
  do return child.parent.notification?.status==succeeded
 scenario recordParentStatus(child:Child) by=members -> bool
  do
   let successful=child.parent.notification?.status==succeeded
   set child {label="Observed"}
   return successful
 ## Parent navigation does not grant access to an opaque receipt identity.
 scenario parentId(child:Child) by=members read=true -> text?
  do return child.parent.notification?.id
 scenario recordParentId(child:Child) by=members -> text?
  do return child.parent.notification?.id
 ## Mutation collection predicates also observe through a projected parent view.
 scenario recordQueriedParentStatus(child:Child) by=members -> text
  do
   let matching=Child as candidate where candidate==child and candidate.parent.notification?.status==succeeded
   require count(matching)>0
   set child {label="Observed"}
   return "Observed"
 ## The new association and send share a commit; refusal keeps the prior attempt.
 scenario notify(entry:Entry,to:email,accept:bool) by=members
  do
   send Mail.send {to=to,subject="Actual notification",body="Associated delivery"} as attempt
   set entry {notification=attempt}
   require accept
Then
